ft.title: Log In (valid credentials)
ft.purpose: Verify a Payroll Administrator can log in and reach the role-based dashboard.
ft.prereq: Seeded account padmin exists; app running.
ft.expected: Dashboard (UI-2) opens with welcome banner and role-specific tiles.
ft.observed: Dashboard displayed with welcome banner and tiles: Employees, Attendance, Compensation, Deductions, Payroll, Reports, Audit Log.

ft.title: Log In - account lockout
ft.purpose: Verify the account locks after 5 failed attempts (S1.1).
ft.prereq: Seeded account james exists and is unlocked.
steps: Attempt login as "james" with a wrong password five times.
Attempt login with the correct password.
ft.expected: After the fifth failure the account is locked; the correct password is also refused with a lock message.
ft.observed: Attempts 1-4: "Invalid username or password.". Attempt 5: "Account locked after 5 failed attempts. Contact a System Administrator.". Login with the correct password afterwards still refused: "Account locked after 5 failed attempts. Contact a System Administrator.".

ft.title: Unlock User (System Administrator)
ft.purpose: Verify a System Administrator can restore a locked account.
steps: Log in as james with the correct password.
ft.expected: Account becomes active and login succeeds.
ft.observed: Locked account "james" was listed with an Unlock button; after unlocking, james logged in successfully.

ft.title: Role-based menu and access control
ft.purpose: Verify an Employee sees only permitted menu items and cannot reach admin functions directly (S9.2).
steps: Request the employee list and payroll periods directly through the API.
ft.expected: Only "My Pay Statements" is shown; direct requests are rejected with 403.
ft.observed: Menu shows only ['Home', 'My Pay Statements']. Direct API calls to /api/employees and /api/periods returned HTTP 403 and 403 (permission denied).

ft.title: Unauthenticated access blocked
ft.purpose: Verify protected endpoints reject requests without a session (MW-2).
ft.expected: HTTP 401, no data returned.
ft.observed: Unauthenticated request to a protected endpoint returned HTTP 401.

ft.title: Add Employee and find via Search
ft.purpose: Verify a valid employee is saved and retrievable (S2.1, S2.3).
ft.prereq: Logged in as padmin; Employee List open.
steps: Enter Priya / Nair / priya.nair@pms.test / 2026-02-02, Department Finance, Position Analyst.
ft.expected: Record saved; search result shows the new employee.
ft.observed: Success message "Employee saved." shown; searching "Nair" returns the new row: 10 Priya Nair Finance Analyst Active Deactivate.

ft.title: Search / Filter employees
ft.purpose: Verify search by name and department filter, including no-result case.
steps: Clear text; choose Department = Engineering; Search.
ft.expected: "No employees found." for unknown text; only Engineering employees listed for the filter.
ft.observed: Name "zzzz" -> "No employees found.". Department filter Engineering -> only: 1 Maria Lopez Engineering Engineer Active Deactivate.

ft.title: Add Employee - validation errors
ft.purpose: Verify invalid input is rejected with clear messages and nothing is saved (S11.1).
steps: Enter first name "Bad3" and leave other fields empty.
ft.expected: Error messages displayed per invalid field; employee not created.
ft.observed: Toast: "First name may contain letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only.". Inline messages: ['First name may contain letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only.', 'Last name is required.', 'Email is required.', 'Hire date is required.', 'Select a department.', 'Select a position.']. Form not saved.

ft.title: Deactivate Employee (confirmation)
ft.purpose: Verify irreversible action requires confirmation (S2.2, UX gap check).
ft.expected: Cancel changes nothing; Confirm sets status Inactive.
ft.observed: Deactivate shows a confirmation dialog; Cancel left the employee Active; Confirm changed status to Inactive.

ft.title: Enter Attendance hours
ft.purpose: Verify regular and overtime hours are stored for an employee (S3.1, S3.2).
ft.expected: Both entries saved and shown in the grid.
ft.observed: Both days saved and listed: 2026-10-01 8 0 | 2026-10-02 8 2.

ft.title: Overtime approval-threshold flag
ft.purpose: Verify excessive overtime is flagged (S3.3).
ft.expected: Saved with a warning that overtime exceeds the approval threshold.
ft.observed: Overtime of 11 h saved with warning: "Overtime exceeds approval threshold and is flagged for review.". Entry then corrected to 1 h (existing day overwritten, no duplicate).

ft.title: Compensation Setup - load, edit, persist
ft.purpose: Verify compensation is stored and reloaded (S4.1, S4.2).
ft.expected: Existing values prefill; new value persists.
ft.observed: Existing compensation loaded (78000); changed to 80000 and persisted after re-selecting the employee (shown 80000); restored to 78000 for later tests.

ft.title: Add / remove Deduction
ft.purpose: Verify deductions can be added and removed per employee (S5.1).
ft.expected: Row added then removed.
ft.observed: Deduction list grew from 2 to 3 rows after adding "Union Dues" ($20 flat); Remove returned it to 2.

ft.title: Create payroll period (+ overlap/date checks)
ft.purpose: Verify period creation and rejection of overlapping or reversed periods (S6.1).
ft.prereq: Logged in as padmin; Payroll screen open.
ft.expected: First saved; the other two rejected with messages.
ft.observed: Period 2026-10-01..2026-10-14 created. Overlapping period -> "This period overlaps an existing payroll period.". End before start -> "End date cannot be before start date.".

ft.title: Calculate Payroll (accuracy)
ft.purpose: Verify gross, deduction and net amounts equal independently computed values (S6.2, S6.3).
ft.prereq: Period created; Maria: 16 reg h + 2 OT h @ $40, 1.5x, bonus $100, 12% tax + $85 insurance; James $78,000; Daniel $95,000 + $250 bonus, 5%; Aisha no hours.
steps: Compare each row with hand calculation.
ft.observed: Results matched hand calculations - Maria Lopez: gross $860.00, deductions $188.20, net $671.80; James Carter: gross $3,000.00, deductions $450.00, net $2,550.00; Aisha Khan: gross $0.00, deductions $0.00, net $0.00; Daniel Okafor: gross $3,903.85, deductions $195.19, net $3,708.66. Employees without compensation (new hires) skipped. Status = Calculated.

ft.title: Finalize requires second approver
ft.purpose: Verify the calculating user cannot also finalize (S6.4 second-person authorization).
steps: As padmin, click Finalize and confirm.
ft.expected: Rejected; status unchanged.
ft.observed: Same user (who calculated) attempted Finalize -> "A second authorized person must finalize this period."; status stays "Calculated".

ft.title: Finalize payroll (second approver, confirmation)
ft.purpose: Verify a different authorized user can finalize and that a confirmation dialog protects the action.
ft.expected: Cancel leaves status; Confirm sets status Finalized.
ft.observed: Confirmation dialog appeared; Cancel kept status "Calculated"; Confirm by finance user fin1 set status "Finalized".

ft.title: Finalized period is locked
ft.purpose: Verify finalized data cannot be recalculated or edited (S6.4, S10.2).
steps: Click Calculate Payroll on the finalized period.
Submit attendance dated inside the period.
ft.expected: Both operations rejected.
ft.observed: Recalculate -> "Period is finalized and locked.". Attendance edit inside the period -> "This date belongs to a finalized payroll period and cannot be changed.".

ft.title: Employee views and downloads own Pay Statement
ft.purpose: Complete journey end: employee self-service (S7.1, S7.2).
steps: Open My Pay Statements; choose the period.
ft.expected: Earnings, deductions and net pay shown (gross $860.00, net $671.80); download succeeds.
ft.observed: Maria sees her statement: gross $860.00, net $671.80. Download produced a file containing the same net pay.

ft.title: Employee cannot read another employee's pay data
ft.purpose: Verify record-level restriction (S12.2).
ft.prereq: Maria logged in; James also has a finalized statement.
ft.expected: Only the caller's own data is returned; payroll results forbidden (403).
ft.observed: Request that tried to read employee 2's statement returned Maria's own data ("Maria Lopez"); payroll results endpoint returned HTTP 403.

ft.title: Payroll Summary report
ft.purpose: Verify the report totals equal the sum of the calculated rows (S8.1).
steps: Open Reports; choose the period; click Generate.
ft.expected: Totals: gross $7,763.85; net $6,930.46.

ft.title: Audit log records and filters activity
ft.purpose: Verify important actions are logged and filterable (S10.1).
ft.expected: Events present; filter restricts rows.
ft.observed: Audit log lists LOGIN_FAILED, CALCULATE_PAYROLL, FINALIZE_PAYROLL, CREATE_EMPLOYEE, SAVE_ATTENDANCE events with user and timestamp. Filter by user "fin1" shows only that user's actions (including FINALIZE_PAYROLL).
